description: React component for auto-synchronizing SQL editor tabs in Apache Superset's SqlLab, handling saving, updating, and deleting query editor states with debounce and interval mechanisms.

methods.name: hasUnsavedChanges
methods.description: Checks if a query editor has unsaved changes based on local storage or updated timestamp.

methods.name: filterUnsavedQueryEditorList
methods.description: Filters a list of query editors to include only those with unsaved changes.

methods.name: EditorAutoSync
methods.description: Main React functional component that manages auto-syncing of query editor tabs.
